title: TCGA-LUAD project metadata in NCI Genomic Data Commons
description: Authoritative GDC project-level metadata and data-discovery entry point for The Cancer Genome Atlas lung adenocarcinoma project; individual files have varied access controls.
unit_of_observation: GDC project metadata, not a patient-level or gene-level dataset
cohort_definition: TCGA-LUAD project source context; project data includes heterogeneous modalities and access classes. Gene-level analyses require additional file, case and mutation filters.

access.notes: Project metadata is open. Underlying GDC files can be open or controlled; controlled files require authorization, consent compliance, and tokens.

reuse.notes: GDC projects may mix publicly accessible metadata with restricted data and study-level reuse requirements; verify before redistribution.

release.label: live GDC project metadata; mutable across releases
